title: BIRCH
description: LMH will provide Technical Assistance to the MoHS to enhance quality implementation of the NCHWP. In collaboration with DPHC / CHW Hub and partners, we’ll standardize operational documents (Operational Plan, SOPs, TORs, and other tools, etc.), strengthen coordination and management, conduct quality review processes mostly at subnational level, and use data for CHW recruitment, training, supervision, and quality improvement.

title: Kambia
description: The project is aimed at developing a supervision tool and process guideline for the CHW programs in Sierra Leone.
